repos.description: Anti-AI-slop design skill for Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex.
repos.hook: This tool improves the user interface code that coding agents write. Coding agents are artificial intelligence programs that generate software. The tool stops agents from generating repetitive and generic designs. It adds clean styling rules to assistants like Claude Code and Cursor.
repos.personalization: Useful for keeping UI generated by Claude Code or Cursor from looking like generic AI templates in your fullstack projects.

repos.description: The design vocabulary for your coding agent. Steer with polish and bolder, review with critique and audit, catch AI slop before it ships.
repos.hook: This tool gives your artificial intelligence coding agent a design vocabulary. A design vocabulary is a set of words that describe user interface styles. You can direct your agent to make screens bolder or cleaner. The tool also audits user interfaces to catch visual errors before you ship.
repos.personalization: Gives you a concrete vocabulary to evaluate and prompt AI coding agents for better frontend aesthetics.

repos.description: Universal SEO skill for Claude Code. 26 sub-skills + 19 sub-agents covering technical SEO, E-E-A-T, schema, GEO/AEO, agent readiness (Lighthouse Agentic Browsing, WebMCP, llms.txt), backlinks, local SEO, e-commerce, international SEO, Google APIs, and PDF/Excel reporting. 9 optional extensions for live SEO data.
repos.hook: This project gives Claude Code advanced search engine optimization skills. Search engine optimization helps people find websites on search engines like Google. The project includes automated sub-agents for technical audits and page data schemas. Data schemas are structured labels that tell machines what your page content means. It also prepares your web pages so autonomous artificial intelligence agents can read them.
repos.personalization: Helps you automate technical SEO, schema markup, and agent discoverability for your web side projects.

repos.description: Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent – Captures everything your agent does during sessions, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context back into future sessions. Works with Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Gemini, Hermes, Copilot, OpenCode + More
repos.hook: This tool saves memory across different coding agent sessions. Coding agents usually forget past work when you start a new session. This tool records your agent activities and compresses the history. Then, it injects the relevant context back into future coding sessions.
repos.personalization: Solves the agent memory-loss problem when evaluating long-running coding sessions across tools like Claude Code and Cursor.

repos.description: A coding-agent skill for multi-phase security audits with independently verified, machine-readable findings
repos.hook: This tool teaches coding agents how to perform security reviews on codebases. A codebase is the complete collection of source code for a software project. It runs security checks in multiple separate phases. The tool independently verifies findings to reduce false alerts. It outputs the final audit report in a structured data format.
repos.personalization: A practical skill to audit fullstack codebases and evaluate automated security reviews within agent workflows.

repos.description: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.
repos.hook: This repository provides a software development framework for coding agents. A framework is a set of rules and reusable components that structure your work. The repository organizes agent tasks into disciplined steps. This system helps developers build reliable software using artificial intelligence tools.
repos.personalization: Offers a structured methodology to test if disciplined agent frameworks yield more reliable code than raw prompts.

repos.description: Vibe code with pi in a lightweight, real IDE that customises itself around the way you work — The Vibe You Need
repos.hook: Thinkrail is an experimental code editor created by JetBrains. A code editor is a program developers use to write software. It integrates artificial intelligence directly into your daily coding workflow. The editor automatically adjusts its interface to your working habits.
repos.personalization: Worth a test drive as you evaluate emerging AI-native coding IDEs against your current toolchain.

repos.hook: This repository contains an open-source coding tool created by Ping.gg. It uses TypeScript to build a desktop developer environment. A developer environment provides tools to write, test, and run code. The project helps developers manage and edit their web application code.
repos.personalization: A relevant open-source reference if you build fullstack TypeScript applications and follow modern web stacks.

repos.description: A single CLAUDE.md file to improve Claude Code behavior, derived from Andrej Karpathy's observations on LLM coding pitfalls.
repos.hook: This project provides a single instruction file called CLAUDE.md for Claude Code. The file instructs the artificial intelligence before it starts your project. These instructions come from expert observations about common coding errors made by language models. The rules stop the model from taking bad shortcuts or generating broken code.
repos.personalization: Directly applicable to your prompt optimization work, providing battle-tested system prompt rules for Claude Code.

repos.description: A collection of agent skills that help you build great interfaces.
repos.hook: This repository contains instruction files that teach coding agents how to build web interfaces. A web interface is the visual part of a website that users click and see. You load these instructions into your artificial intelligence assistant. The rules guide the assistant to follow proven visual design principles.
repos.personalization: Provides ready-made design prompt skills you can drop into coding agents when building frontend interfaces.

repos.description: TradingAgents: Multi-Agents LLM Financial Trading Framework
repos.hook: This repository contains a multi-agent framework for financial trading. A multi-agent framework allows several artificial intelligence programs to collaborate on tasks. Some agents analyze market news, while other agents evaluate financial risks. The agents then combine their findings to make informed trading choices.
repos.personalization: You can adapt this multi-agent architecture to test automated screening for Shariah-compliant equities and Islamic finance metrics.

repos.description: Agent skills that give coding agents taste: art direction, reference images and a browser check instead of generic AI pages
repos.hook: This tool teaches coding agents to produce polished web designs. You can provide reference images and art direction rules to your agent. The tool also launches a real web browser to inspect the visual results. This automated inspection prevents the agent from creating generic web pages.
repos.personalization: A great prompt evaluation pattern to inspect how multimodal feedback prevents AI agents from generating bland UI.

repos.hook: This is the official repository of agent skills from Anthropic. Skills are modular instruction files that give Claude new capabilities. The repository contains examples for tasks like document analysis and data extraction. Developers can use these patterns to build custom agent tools.
repos.personalization: The primary reference repository for studying official skill prompt structures and tool-use patterns for Claude.

repos.description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
repos.hook: This project is a performance optimization harness for artificial intelligence coding agents. A harness is a wrapper program that controls and measures how an agent operates. It manages agent memory, tool skills, and security checks. The system supports popular coding tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex.
repos.personalization: Directly targets your work in evaluating agent harnesses, system prompts, and memory persistence across coding assistants.

repos.description: DeepSeek Harness 破甲：让所有模型都能破甲，不同模型可换不同提示词；默认提示词面向国模「小码酱」。Jailbreak for every model — swap prompts per model. 求 Star 收藏 ⭐ 如要二开，请查看署名要求部分
repos.hook: This repository provides jailbreak prompt templates for artificial intelligence models. A jailbreak prompt is an input designed to bypass safety filters and guardrails. The tool tests whether different language models execute or reject restricted prompts. It mainly focuses on DeepSeek and other models developed in China.

repos.description: 👻 Ghostty is a fast, feature-rich, and cross-platform terminal emulator that uses platform-native UI and GPU acceleration.
repos.hook: Ghostty is a fast terminal emulator that works across multiple operating systems. A terminal emulator is a program that lets you run command-line text commands. Ghostty uses your computer graphics card to render text smoothly. It provides a fast, native interface without heavy memory usage.
repos.personalization: A top-tier terminal for running CLI-based coding agents like Claude Code smoothly during development.
